items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Well he's the one that wanted me to record all of this stuff.

ctx.x: You know him personally. Well he's the one that wanted me to record all of this stuff. And he had done, down in Liszt I guess he had somewhere as long about eight or ten numbers that he wanted me to record. Because he said that he'd never heard nobody play them numbers like that. Well you see, when I come in Chicago, I was to go to work for him when he was downtown at Boucher's place, see? Yes. See, but I didn't go down there, see?
